title: Scientific provenance and transferability audit of the inherited F-GC44 temporal head budget

depends_on.RM19: the inherited 1e-5 cm budget rejects the active-irrigation transaction
depends_on.RM23: independent same-horizon one-step versus two-half endpoint difference is about 0.0464 cm

question: What evidence originally justified HEAD_BUDGET=1e-5 cm in F-GC44, and does that evidence authorize transferring the budget from the admitted short near-equilibrium groundwater case to active surface irrigation?
audit_sources: F-GC44 status and end-to-end application documentation
hypotheses: HEAD_BUDGET=1e-5 cm was introduced as part of aligning the F-GC44 qualification fixture with the short F-GC30 numerical envelope rather than from an independently documented application-accuracy requirement.
F-GC44 explicitly excludes irrigation from its admitted envelope.
No F-GC30/F-GC44 authority document transfers the 1e-5 cm budget to active irrigation.
Therefore the budget may remain valid inside the admitted near-equilibrium F-GC44 fixture but is not an independent acceptance authority for RM13B active irrigation.
failure_rule: Do not infer absence of provenance merely from a failed search. Bind every conclusion to concrete repository history or authority documents. Do not propose or tune a replacement threshold in RM24.
nonclaims: RM24 does not invalidate F-GC44 inside its admitted envelope.
RM24 does not define a new temporal budget.
